info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Account Transfer-spec
info.description: The Account Transfer Management API allows businesses to facilitate the transfer of funds between accounts. By utilizing this API, users can initiate and manage transfers securely for specified accounts, enhancing financial transactions within banking applications. This API is designed for financial institutions and businesses that require seamless integration of fund transfer services. Typical use cases include automating account transfers and providing users with real-time transfer capabilities.

post.summary: Initiate a transfer for a specific account.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new transfer linked to the specified account. You can provide the necessary details for the transfer, such as amount, recipient information, and any relevant notes to successfully process the transaction.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a transfer operation for the specified account. It must contain all necessary details about the transfer such as the recipient's information, the transfer amount, and any relevant payment details.
